physicalNotes: Radius 1.237 +/- 0.054 solar radii from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar radius of HAT-P-16 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract): 860,581 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.218 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar mass of HAT-P-16 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6158 +/- 80 K from Yalçınkaya et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-16 b's parameter set from Yalçınkaya et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.530.2475Y/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
